ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels localized in central lobes against 40% low-intensity (black) pixels at margins and central notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral contiguous high-intensity white blobs. Left lobe: white field from mid-wing to distal region with internal black mottling. Right lobe: white field from mid-wing to distal region. Separated by a low-intensity black vertical central band.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression; calculated internal angle of approximately 85 degrees with depth penetrating roughly 20% of total visible fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency irregular peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary; amplitude variations visible as 3-10 pixel jagged protrusions against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward convex trajectory terminating in sharp posterior-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark-intensity circular clusters detected within the white fields, predominantly along the lower and distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Clear horizontal low-intensity linear mark visible on the left lobe white field; smaller vertical linear marks visible on the right lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular notches on the trailing edge of the left lobe; distinct dark indentation on the leading edge of the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density black and white mottled texture at the extreme distal tips showing high-contrast localized pixel clusters.
